units.name: Infantry
units.description: Foot infantry. Strong in rough and urban terrain.

units.name: Light Infantry
units.description: Stripped-down infantry optimised for difficult terrain and rapid movement.

units.name: Airborne Infantry
units.description: Parachute infantry. Inserts deep, then fights light and hard.

units.name: Air Assault Infantry
units.description: Helicopter-borne manoeuvre infantry. Seizes objectives behind the line.

units.name: Mountain Infantry
units.description: Alpine and high-ground specialists. Holds terrain nothing else can reach.

units.name: Marine Infantry
units.description: Amphibious infantry. Fights from the water's edge inland.

units.name: Special Forces
units.description: Elite raiding, DA and deep reconnaissance element.

units.name: Armour
units.description: Main battle tanks. Breakthrough and shock element.

units.name: Combined Arms
units.description: Integrated armour, infantry and supporting fires under one commander.

units.name: Armoured Reconnaissance
units.description: Cavalry. Screens the force and fights for information in vehicles.

units.name: Reconnaissance
units.description: Screens, scouts and finds the enemy. Very high view range.

units.name: Anti-tank
units.description: ATGM teams and tank destroyers. Lethal vs armour.

units.name: Mechanised Infantry
units.description: Infantry mounted in IFVs, fights mounted or dismounted.

units.name: Motorised Infantry
units.description: Truck/APC-mobile infantry. Fast on roads, light protection.

units.name: Artillery
units.description: Tube artillery battalion slice. Long-range fires.

units.name: Self-Propelled Artillery
units.description: Armoured guns that shoot and scoot. Survives counter-battery.

units.name: Towed Artillery
units.description: Light towed guns. Cheap and air-portable, slow to displace.

units.name: Rocket Artillery
units.description: MLRS. Very long-range saturation and precision fires.

units.name: Mortar
units.description: Close-support indirect fires organic to infantry.

units.name: Surface-to-Surface Missile
units.description: Theatre missile battery. Reaches the enemy's depth in one shot.

units.name: Deep Precision Strike
units.description: Ground-launched precision fires against high-value targets.

units.name: Coastal Defence Missile
units.description: Land-based anti-ship battery. Closes a sea lane from the shore.

units.name: Forward Observer
units.description: Eyes for the guns. Sharply improves artillery accuracy.

units.name: Joint Fires Cell
units.description: Coordinates artillery, UAS and air. Fires multiplier.

units.name: JTAC / Air Control Party
units.description: Talks close air support onto the target. The link between ground and air.

units.name: Target-acquisition Unit
units.description: Acoustic and optical sensors that locate enemy firing positions.

units.name: Counter-Battery Radar
units.description: Tracks incoming shells back to the gun that fired them.

units.name: MANPADS
units.description: Shoulder-launched SAM teams. Very short range, goes anywhere infantry goes.

units.name: Air Defence
units.description: Gun/short-range AD. Protects manoeuvre units from air and UAS.

units.name: SHORAD
units.description: Mobile short-range air defence that keeps up with the manoeuvre force.

units.name: Self-Propelled AA Gun
units.description: Tracked AA guns. Murderous against helicopters, drones and light troops.

units.name: Medium-Range Air Defence
units.description: Area air defence over a division's ground.

units.name: Surface-to-air Missile
units.description: Medium/long-range SAM battery. Area air denial.

units.name: Long-Range Air Defence
units.description: Strategic air defence. Denies an entire operational sector to aircraft.

units.name: Missile Defence
units.description: Ballistic and cruise missile interception.

units.name: Counter-UAS
units.description: Dedicated drone-defeat: jammers, guns, interceptors.

units.name: Air-defence Radar
units.description: Surveillance radar. Extends air picture for AD and C-UAS.

units.name: Air Surveillance Radar
units.description: Long-range radar generating the regional air picture.

units.name: Air Defence C2
units.description: Ties sensors to shooters. Without it the AD units fight alone.

units.name: Attack Helicopter
units.description: Rotary-wing anti-armour. Arrives fast, kills tanks, leaves.

units.name: Reconnaissance Helicopter
units.description: Armed scout helicopters. Finds targets for the attack flight.

units.name: Transport Helicopter
units.description: Lifts an air assault company over the front line.

units.name: Utility Helicopter
units.description: General-purpose battlefield aviation: liaison, resupply, lift.

units.name: MEDEVAC Helicopter
units.description: Air casualty evacuation. Turns wounded into returned soldiers.

units.name: Close Air Support
units.description: Ground-attack aircraft working directly for the ground commander.

units.name: Strike Aircraft
units.description: Operational-depth strike. Bridges, depots, headquarters.

units.name: Fighter
units.description: Air superiority. Everything else in the air depends on this.

units.name: ISR Aircraft
units.description: Airborne surveillance. Sees deeper than anything on the ground.

units.name: Airborne Early Warning
units.description: Airborne radar and battle management. The air picture, airborne.

units.name: Tactical Airlift
units.description: Moves troops and freight between theatres and onto rough strips.

units.name: Air-to-Air Refuelling
units.description: Extends every other airframe's reach and time on station.

units.name: Airborne Electronic Warfare
units.description: Jams and kills radars so the strike package gets through.

units.name: UAS Operator Team
units.description: Small-UAS crews flying quadcopters and fixed-wing sUAS.

units.name: Reconnaissance UAS
units.description: Tactical ISR drones. Deep, persistent surveillance.

units.name: Armed UAS
units.description: MALE/attack drones with guided munitions.

units.name: Loitering-munition Unit
units.description: One-way attack drones. High lethality vs vehicles and guns.

units.name: FPV Attack UAS
units.description: Cheap first-person-view one-way drones. Attrition weapon of the modern front.

units.name: Deep-Strike UAS
units.description: Long-range one-way attack drones. Reaches the strategic rear.

units.name: Interceptor UAS
units.description: Drone-on-drone interception. The cheap answer to cheap drones.

units.name: Electronic Warfare UAS
units.description: Airborne jamming from a small airframe. Denies links and GNSS forward.

units.name: Communications Relay UAS
units.description: Airborne relay extending the tactical network past terrain masking.

units.name: Cargo UAS
units.description: Unmanned resupply to positions a truck cannot reach.

units.name: Decoy UAS
units.description: Saturates air defences and makes them show themselves.

units.name: Surface Combatant
units.description: Frigate/destroyer. Area air defence, land attack and sea control.

units.name: Submarine
units.description: Undersea warfare. Cannot be found, cannot defend itself once it is.

units.name: Patrol Craft
units.description: Fast littoral and coastal patrol. Cheap presence in narrow water.

units.name: Mine Countermeasure Vessel
units.description: Clears naval mines. Slow, fragile, and the only way a port reopens.

units.name: Amphibious Warfare Ship
units.description: Lands marine infantry and its vehicles across a beach.

units.name: Naval Logistics
units.description: Replenishment at sea. Keeps a fleet on station instead of in port.

units.name: Logistics
units.description: Sustainment planning and distribution node.

units.name: Supply
units.description: Ammunition, fuel and rations resupply point.

units.name: Ammunition Supply
units.description: Dedicated ammunition holding and distribution. Guns stop without it.

units.name: Fuel / POL
units.description: Bulk fuel storage and distribution. The armoured force's real limit.

units.name: Transport
units.description: Truck transport. Moves units and freight.

units.name: Movement Control
units.description: Runs the route network so convoys do not meet each other head-on.

units.name: Maintenance
units.description: Repair and recovery of vehicles and equipment.

units.name: Recovery
units.description: Drags casualties of the mechanical kind off the battlefield.

units.name: Ordnance
units.description: Technical support to weapons and ammunition.

units.name: Medical
units.description: Role 1/2 medical. Reduces losses of nearby units.

units.name: Medical Evacuation
units.description: Ground casualty evacuation to the treatment chain.

units.name: Field Hospital
units.description: Role 2/3 surgical capability. Static, large, and worth defending.

units.name: Water Supply
units.description: Purification and distribution. The first thing to run out in the heat.

units.name: Field Services
units.description: Laundry, bath, mortuary affairs and the rest of what keeps troops human.

units.name: Personnel Support
units.description: Replacements and administration. Refills formations that have bled.

units.name: Headquarters
units.description: Command element. Boosts organisation of nearby units.

units.name: Tactical Command Post
units.description: Forward C2 node for the drone/fires fight.

units.name: Signals
units.description: Communications backbone. Enables command and control.

units.name: Engineer
units.description: Mobility, counter-mobility, fortifications and breaching.

units.name: Assault Engineer
units.description: Pioneers who breach obstacles under fire, with the assault.

units.name: Bridging
units.description: Tactical bridging. Turns a river from a stop line into a crossing.

units.name: Route Clearance
units.description: Opens and keeps open the movement corridors everything else uses.

units.name: Counter-IED
units.description: Detection and defeat of improvised explosive devices.

units.name: Mine Clearance
units.description: Breaches minefields and explosive obstacles.

units.name: Mine Laying
units.description: Counter-mobility. Turns open ground into ground nobody crosses.

units.name: Construction Engineer
units.description: Roads, airstrips, fortifications and base infrastructure.

units.name: Geospatial Engineer
units.description: Terrain analysis and mapping. Decides where the force can actually go.

units.name: EOD
units.description: Explosive ordnance disposal teams.

units.name: CBRN
units.description: CBRN reconnaissance and decontamination.

units.name: Smoke / Obscuration
units.description: Screens movement and blinds observation across a whole frontage.

units.name: Camouflage and Deception
units.description: Decoys and signature management. Makes the enemy shoot at nothing.

units.name: Military Police
units.description: Route control, security, detention, rear-area operations.

units.name: Intelligence
units.description: Analysis and fusion. Improves spotting for the whole force.

units.name: HUMINT
units.description: Human intelligence collection. Sees intent, not just equipment.

units.name: Counter-Intelligence
units.description: Finds and disrupts the enemy's collection against you.

units.name: GEOINT
units.description: Imagery and geospatial intelligence exploitation.

units.name: Signals-intelligence
units.description: Intercept and geolocation of enemy emitters.

units.name: Battlefield Surveillance
units.description: Persistent observation of a named area of interest.

units.name: Ground Surveillance Radar
units.description: Detects ground movement through weather and darkness.

units.name: Electronic Warfare
units.description: Jamming, direction finding and electronic attack.

units.name: Counter-UAS EW
units.description: EW element focused on the UAS fight: link and GNSS denial.

units.name: Cyber Defence
units.description: Protects networks and C2. Invisible until the day it fails.

units.name: Cyberspace Operations
units.description: Offensive cyber effects against enemy systems.

units.name: Psychological Operations
units.description: Influence operations against enemy and civilian morale.

units.name: Civil-Military Cooperation
units.description: Works the civilian side of the battlespace so the rear stays quiet.

units.name: Public Affairs
units.description: Military information and media handling.

units.name: Meteorological
units.description: Weather and atmospherics for aviation and ballistic corrections.

units.name: Space Support
units.description: Space-enabled ISR, navigation and communications support.
